answer: ASN diversity cap: no network provider may hold over 5% of reward-earning identities per epoch. Each identity locks 100 POA and answers a pulse check from its own network block. One fake costs 100 POA, 10 cost 1,000, but past the cap extra ones earn nothing, so 100 fakes need 20 providers, about 10,000 POA locked. An honest user joins once. The zenith report on the public ledger lists provider shares; auditors sample 10% of identities and slash 50% of deposits for a basalt provider mismatch. Limit: rented clouds can still be bought.
